hook: Energy and compute for a whole space station are priced under this dome.
The Charter Authority sits in the densest core on the station.
The arbitration courts of a space city sit behind this portico.
description: The arbitration courts of a space city sit behind this portico. A columned pediment stands on a street of civic frontages in Noordung, beside the Exchange and Charter Hall.

hook: The first thing a visitor sees of Concordia is a zero-g arrival hall.
description: The first thing a visitor sees of Concordia is a zero-g arrival hall. Signs, public structure and docking views greet passengers as they float in from Earth and the Moon.

hook: A spacecraft floats unsupported in a yard much larger than itself.
A timber boardwalk runs out to a glass handrail 342 m up the end wall, 50 m under the sky.
description: A timber boardwalk runs out to a glass handrail 342 m up the forward end wall of Tsiolkovsky (Rotor 1), about 50 m under the artificial sky. The whole city lies below you.

hook: The Arbor interchange: a 108 m platform with screen doors and a train waiting.
The metro runs 45 m overhead so the street underneath stays free.
Ride through the sky and the blue ceiling becomes a lit machine.
description: Ride through the sky and the blue ceiling becomes a lit machine. In the ascender cabin the opposite city hangs overhead and the open interior of the rotor lies beyond.

hook: Lettuce, basil and kale grow in racks under LED rigs, high in the rotor.
description: Lettuce, basil and kale grow in racks under LED rigs, high in the rotor. A visitor gallery looks down on four stages of growth, the nutrient channels and the harvest gantry.

hook: An ordinary street, except the ground curves up and the buildings run on out of sight.
description: An ordinary street, except the ground curves up and the buildings run on out of sight. This is Tsiolkovsky (Rotor 1) at eye height, on a floor that weighs a full 1 g.

hook: Four rotors, a spine, a shipyard and a spaceport on one 21 km axis.
